# REQ: LANG-851 LANG-852
# cython: language_level=3
from libc.math cimport sqrt

cdef struct Point:
    double x
    double y

cdef inline double norm(Point p) nogil:
    return sqrt(p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y)

cpdef int greet(str name, Py_ssize_t times=1) except -1:
    cdef int i
    cdef bint ok = True
    for i in range(times):
        print(f"Hello, {name}!")
    return 0 if ok else 1
